spanish: No harán para ustedes ídolos, y escultura y estela no levantarán para ustedes, y piedra de imaginería no darán en su tierra para postrarse sobre ella, porque yo Jehová su Dios.

findings.issue: משכית is one feminine singular noun; imaginería is a collective or craft noun and slightly generalizes that single figure.

notes: 2mp futures with ustedes keep the addressees; the כי clause stays verbless with no unmarked copula.
